name: Zohar
overview: The name Zohar appears in Scripture referring to two distinct individuals: one as the father of Ephron the Hittite, whose land was purchased for Abraham’s burial (Genesis 23:8; 25:9), and the other as a son of Simeon, listed among his descendants (Exodus 6:15; Genesis 46:10). These references highlight Zohar's role in the genealogical and historical context of God's covenant people, emphasizing the importance of family lines and the fulfillment of God's promises through Abraham's lineage.
